entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You... reserved this place?
Of course.
I put in a lot of work.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hey. You don't have to look so smug.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But... thank you.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Yeah, I can tell...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: What, you want a gold star? A pat[n]on the head?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I guess part of me still saw you as[n]a troublemaker.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But every time I see you, you seem[n]like more of an adult...
Well, thank you.
Glad to hear that.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: See, that's exactly what I'm talking[n]about. I don't know how you got so[n]smooth.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm not the one who's supposed to[n]be getting butterflies right now.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Wait, I mean—not that I am!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...I-I'll be right back.
When should I give her the gift?
○○○ is calling me...
I can't answer this now...!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'm ba-ack!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Wait, weren't you getting a call?
It's not a big deal.
Don't worry about it.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You don't say.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Sorry about that!

entries.speaker: Announcer
entries.en: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for[n]joining us on this special day.

entries.speaker: Announcer
entries.en: We wish you all an unforgettable[n]evening, with one last finishing touch[n]from us...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Huh? What the heck—

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Wow...
I have a gift for you.
I want you to have this.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: They're... for me...?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Thank... you...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You can't scare me like this! I was[n]about to look around for the hidden[n]camera!
It's all real.
What, is this a soap opera now?
Surprise.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Yeah, you're right... This is real, huh?[n]I was just so happy, it felt like a dream.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You just keep finding ways to surprise[n]me...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hey, it's not impossible! You already[n]know I'm a pretty good actress.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Well... You definitely got me.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You really are strange.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: To me, you were just some punk with[n]a record... Turns out you're a phantom[n]thief. Protector of the weak.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But you're not just some teacher's[n]pet, either.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: The only thing about you that's[n]consistent is...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You're always fighting for someone[n]else's sake. Not just yourself.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I genuinely admire that. Whatever[n]else you are, you're a good person.
Thanks.
You're making me blush.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...White Day isn't over yet, right?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: So... we can spend a little more time[n]together.
Kawakami and I spent some[n]time alone together...
entries.uk: Ми з Кавакамі провели[n]трохи часу наодинці...

entries.en: Once it got late, I walked her[n]back to the station...
